identityStatus: The mapped one-storey perimeter measures about 44 by 11 metres. The photographs establish shallow roofs over parallel gallery rooms, low lower walls, and a taller clean eastern gable.

terrainContact.basis: Original Mapzen elevation at the transition from the southern museum wall to the stepped entrance terrace.

notes: Photographs show pale rendered walls, red clay tiled edges, dark rectangular grille windows, a shallow arrival canopy and lower buff masonry terrace. The west and north walls are scaled from the native envelope.
